payload.text: (2026-10-26, hv's ruling relayed by molt-vc, received by vc before vc's clock read of 11:45Z; molt-vc stamped hv's words about 11:40Z on its own clock) LANDED WORKTREES: TEXT IN INTENT NOW, TOOL IN DEVBIN. hv, verbatim: "Text in Intent now, tool in devbin". (1) Intent 3.2.7 adds the removal step to the fold text: /in-whiteboard's Folding section and /in-finish's localfold, as vc's reading proposed. The author removes a unit's worktree at the chain END that lands it, after checks run from outside the worktree: its index tree equals the landed bank; nothing is untracked; its base is an ancestor of main; no stash entry names it. A re-bank that supersedes a worktree removes the old one. It is a light leg, filed as an Intent issue and landed BEFORE the kovacs preflight, whose order is then re-aimed at the new HEAD, since hv approved it going in ahead of the kovacs check so that one preflight covers it. (2) The report-and-remove tool is a devbin issue for devbin's next release, after 0.1.15, so every estate gets it. vc's reading is its spec, and refs/bank/vc/tools/wt-inventory.sh and wt-pass2.sh are its measure; devbin-vc files it after hv's 0.1.15 cut. (3) The removals of the stale worktrees wait for hv's ~/Devel Spotlight exclusion, on molt-vc's word.
